description: Defines the QuicGsoBatchWriter class for batching QUIC packets with GSO support in UDP sockets, including methods for batch support, flushing, and release time management.

classes.name: QuicGsoBatchWriter
classes.description: A class for sending QUIC packets in batches using UDP socket's GSO capability, with support for release timing and kernel bug workarounds.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Checks if release time is supported.

methods.name: CanBatch
methods.description: Determines if a packet can be batched based on buffer, addresses, options, and release time.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the release time from packet options.

methods.name: NowInNanosForReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds for release timing.
